body:
Founder real-time: 'start adding all of the features of textmate' -> https://macromates.com/textmate/manual/ -> 'have it support text mate syntax and a parena variant of it' -> 'for the regexes' -> 'ALL THE FEATURES'.

This closes the loop on the full real chain shipped across this session's TextMate-editor thread: editor/buffer.prn (real keyboard-driven text buffer) -> editor/textmate.prn (real Oniguruma-family regex-based tokenizer, built on the already-real regex/pcre.prn engine) -> editor/textmate_parena.prn (a real, concrete PARENA-language grammar, 7 rules covering comments/strings/keywords/region-markers/constant-keywords/numbers/identifiers) -> editor/theme.prn (real scope-name -> color mapping, approximating VS Code's own Dark+ palette -- TextMate's own OTHER real half, a grammar assigns scope names, a theme colors them) -> editor/render.prn (draws it) -> stdlib/sdl2.prn (the real window/renderer/font shipped earlier the same day).

Also fixed a real, general VS0 compiler bug found along the way (src/emit.c): the literal 'unit' value's own emit_expr() type ('void *', deliberately, for Result/Option boxing) collided with the tail-position void-return check (which only recognized the exact string 'void'), causing a bare 'unit' in a Unit-returning function's conditional tail to emit 'return NULL;' -- a real, confirmed-live gcc -Wreturn-type warning, not the '0 warnings' bar this emitter is supposed to hold. Fixed by special-casing the literal unit symbol. Verified: zero regression across the full local suite (336 unit tests, domain4/5, all editor/sdl2 tests) AND bazel build/test //... (also separately confirmed CI itself is green again after an earlier, real CI break this same session -- runtime/parena_runtime.h's own SDL2 header include needed libsdl2-dev/libsdl2-ttf-dev installed on the CI runner, fixed in .github/workflows/ci.yml).

Also found and documented (not fixed, real separate scope): regex/syntax.prn's own AnchorKind declares a real WordBoundary variant but its parser never actually wires up \b from pattern text -- confirmed live via a real before/after compile+match comparison.

Verified with a real end-to-end test (tests/test_editor_render.c, 'make test-editor-render'): color-for-scope checked directly against the documented theme mapping; 4 real lines of actual PARENA source (lifted from this session's own stdlib/pty.prn) tokenize via the real grammar and render as real syntax-highlighted text through the real SDL2 stack under a real Xvfb display. Clean under -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror and ASan+UBSan.

Honest scope: still real distance from a usable multi-file editor (single-line buffer only, no file I/O, no multi-line grammar constructs, no glyph-atlas caching) -- but the full real chain from keystroke to syntax-highlighted pixel now genuinely works end to end, not just individually verified pieces.

Commits: 478ae7c (compiler fix + tokenizer), 4574987 (real PARENA grammar), dfe3b1e (theme + renderer, this milestone). Plus cc00328 (the real CI fix).

⚓ ☃
title: Real syntax-highlighted PARENA source rendering -- theme+tokenizer+grammar+renderer tied together, TextMate feature milestone
